official_sources.finding: Cloudflare documents that automated suites including Playwright can be detected as bots and recommends dedicated test keys.
The 600* family is a generic challenge failure associated with detected bot behavior; the final digits are internal.
Siteverify success must be checked together with the expected hostname and action.

interpretation: Official test-key success omitted the action even when the browser widget was configured with reports. The unchanged verifier correctly rejects that response. Configuring a different test hostname alone cannot provide a success path with the exact production action check. No equivalent-code success-path result is claimed from these probes.
